==Description==

*'''CAT-120''' might be the first rebounder you will encounter in [[Super Epic Mode]], ''if not [[Tackle]]'', he is in fact the same as [[A-120]].

==Strategies==

When [[CAT-120]] hide in a locker, but when he goes back a bit wait a bit because he might come back immediately, if he doesn't come back after 3 seconds leave your hiding spot and wait until you hear the drums sounds again, if it doesn't come back it's safe to leave
